Daily statistical refits. Continuous market observation. Your own pair-trading desk, built by Grok Bots or Claude Code.

How modular data and the Grok VM make it possible.

Your AI. Your build. Your data.

It\'s called screener-mcp. It\'s an MCP server, so Claude gets 30 tools it calls on its own: financials, shareholding, peers, screens, NSE filings, annual reports, earnings calls and a portfolio tracker.

You ask in plain English. Claude picks the tools.

and more

How to upgrade:

Asked my open-source terminal\'s AI agent for a quick read on CCL Products (NSE: CCL).

It picked its own tools, pulled live price, valuation, its 52-week position and the latest news, and answered in seconds.

Self-hosted, runs on local models.

I built an AI-native stock screener for NSE 🇮🇳

📈 Breakout scanner + live option chain
🤖 Chat with an AI trading agent (5 personas)
🧠 ML-based Nifty gap predictor

Open-source, MIT licensed.

🔗
Generates trading bots and manages risk for Indian equity markets with Zerodha integration using Claude Code.

<Not written with AI>
Everyone is pressurized to build and ship something. Some build hackathon projects with AI and proudly ship it. Some try to build alternatives to tools built by billion dollar...
Who should read this article? — engineers, technical leaders and non-technical leaders dealing with software and AI. I present my thoughts on opportunities to start exploring and shifting focus...

In 2024, Bill Hwang lost $20 billion, and the...

your own algo" 🦇
